fusions.name: Pinning Cast
fusions.desc: Hurls a javelin that deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets and drives it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Set Against the Charge
fusions.desc: A braced thrust at full reach that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Lengthened Grip
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Fresh Arm
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
